witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W1 every job assigned to exactly one worker; W2 worker capacity; W3 activation: worker has >=1 job iff active==1; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE costs (tol 1e-6).

c3_no_link.description: C3 activation error: x<=y link dropped; optimizer never sets y, pays no fixed fee. Feasible, cheaper; violates the activation rule.

c1_bind.description: C1 binding error: objective charges W1<->W2 swapped assignment costs. Constraints untouched; reported objective mismatches recomputed true cost -> W5.
